name: explorer-data
goal: The Harness console is an entity explorer whose address, data and verdicts are exact: /harness/branch/{branch}/... shows the branch tip and /harness/branch/{branch}/commit/{sha}/... a selected commit, across five categories (Pages, Components, Functions, Configs, Services) with entity Overview, Details and History; earlier map, compare, history, growth, activity, query and slash-branch addresses lead into it; a unit is green only when every required test, state, viewport and commit-bound capture passed at the viewed revision; a selected commit is compared with its first parent and a branch tip shows one current capture

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Scope from Daniel's brief and Codex steering (work/opus-approved-designs/data-steering.md): explorer addresses for a branch tip and a selected commit across five categories with Overview, Details and History; every earlier console, report and analytics address leads into it; classification that lists real pages and never presents rules, guides, templates or models as functions; a binary unit-scoped verdict; first-parent comparison at a selected commit and one current capture set at a tip; end-to-end behaviour from recorded artifacts checked against their hash. Specification: specification/features/planned/explorer-data.md. Public contract published first in work/opus-approved-designs/data-status.md: ExplorerLocation with explorerRoute and explorerRoutePath in src/utils/explorerRoute.ts, view-model types in packages/reports/src/models/Explorer.types.ts. Proof agreed: unit tests red on the unchanged implementation then green; the classification checked against this repository's own registry; browser acceptance red on an isolated snapshot of b4afb74 and green on the explorer, with screenshots at the same checkpoints.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Address: src/utils/explorerRoute.ts (ExplorerLocation, explorerRoute, explorerRoutePath, explorerKindCategory), explorerLegacy.ts, consoleCanonical.ts (explorerHome, explorerAddress, explorerExact; consoleCanonical keeps its signature) exported from src/lib/console.ts. Data under packages/reports/src/utils: harnessPage and explorerScope (tip from index.branches, first parent, missing reported), explorerCategory and explorerName (policy checked against this repository's own registry), explorerCoverage and explorerVerdict (binary, unit-scoped), explorerEntities and explorerRelations (page to components to functions; configs, services and support units apart), explorerEvidence (one side at a tip, first-parent pair at a commit), explorerBehavior, explorerArtifact (media read and SHA-256 checked), explorerHistory with historyDetail, reportDestination; types in models/Explorer.types.ts. HarnessConsole.svelte hosts the shell's navbar and the entities' ExplorerContent with these answers. Routes: harness/[...view] serves exact explorer addresses and redirects the rest; the report hub, report page and analytics screens are removed and their addresses redirect into the explorer; data, API, CLI and export endpoints are unchanged. Fixture: scripts/harness-explorer-seed.ts adds a page, two nested components, a config and two scenarios with real end-to-end artifacts to the seeded history, and branch explorer/tip. Not implemented and stated in data-status.md: per-revision change metadata in the prebuilt index for History, and tests per unit.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Unit, red on the unchanged implementation then green, logs in work/explorer-data/logs and test hashes in work/explorer-data/red: explorerRoute 60 of 60 failed on the scaffold; consoleCanonical 7 failed on the b4afb74 file (canonical-unit-RED-2.log); harnessPage 7 of 7 failed on the unchanged file; category, name, scope and verdict 25 of 25; classification policy over this repository's registry 4 failed; entities and relations; evidence and behaviour 16 of 16; history and artifact 12 of 12; verdict hardening 6 failed; equal measurements 1 failed. Now: root focused 89 passed in 6 files, reports focused 78 passed in 12 files, whole reports unit suite 340 passed in 96 files, root tsc clean, svelte-check clean for my files. Browser, in isolated snapshots outside the shared checkout with byte-identical test files (browser-test-hashes-final.txt): RED on b4afb74, 14 failed of 14 (browser-RED-final.log, screenshots red/screenshots-final, routes-earlier-map.png is the old working map route failing the new acceptance); GREEN on the working tree, 20 passed and 1 FAILED of 21 (browser-GREEN-4.log, 23 screenshots in green/screenshots): routes 6 of 6, cache 1, protection 6, evidence 7 of 8. The one failing test is kept as written: the history of a function does not list a commit that changed what it returns without changing its size, because the index holds no per-revision change of a unit. The verify step stays pending: bun run check was not run by assignment, and that acceptance is red.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
Brevity limits, origin-validated inherited proof, logical pages, real end-to-end artifacts, console spec migration.
steps.evidence: Red then green, logs in work/explorer-data/logs3: writing limits 5 boundary tests and 3 CLI tests (explain-brevity.e2e: refused write stores nothing, injected overlong reason fails check and verification, a repository without the declaration keeps long reasons); origin checks on inherited scenarios (record-view 2 tests, coverage guard); reasons without paths; verifier binds actual-capture results to builds (scenario-coverage 2 tests); route page names. Browser on an isolated, re-seeded build of the latest checkout: 51 passed of 51 (browser-FINAL.log, 35 screenshots, hashes in green3/hashes.txt). Reports units 399 passed, root units 561 passed, root e2e subset 44 passed, types, lint and audit clean for my files. All 113 required reasons of my 68 units are recorded within the limits. Twenty route pages make the explorer screens real pages; the scratch registry of this repository lists 21 pages.
